sources.title: One Head is Better than Two: A Polynomial Restriction for Propositional Definite Horn Forgetting
sources.venue: Journal of Logic, Language and Information
sources.role: Primary alignment for polynomial-time, polynomial-size forgetting when each variable is the head of at most one definite Horn rule.

sources.title: Reconstructing a single-head formula to facilitate logical forgetting
sources.role: Single-head Horn definition, forgetting context, and the boundary between an already single-head input and recognition/reconstruction of single-head equivalence.

sources.title: A Computing Procedure for Quantification Theory
sources.role: Classical variable-elimination and resolution basis for the replayed projection step.

claim_boundary: The cited work supports tractable forgetting for single-head definite Horn and classical resolution; C039.1 does not extend that result to arbitrary Horn or arbitrary CNF.
